|strategy=Gregg (Ginsu) Keefer, [[Gold 4]]

One of only three unique lightsabers in the game so far, this can opener is especially useful to the Light Side as it deploys to any [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Skywalker]] with ability higher than 3. With the release of the Cloud City expansion and the new [[Princess Leia]] card with her ability of 4, she can now use the family blade!

The weapon itself is devastating. In addition to adding one to Force drains it will take down even the strongest enemies and leave them with zero forfeit value at battle's end. You simply target for free, draw two destiny and watch out for falling limbs! Now how much would you pay? Add to your Force drains by combining it with [[Lightsaber Proficiency]] and jack up your power in battles by 3 to boot!

And this knife comes gauranteed for life, whoops sorry I slipped into my Ginsu routine again. Seriously though, for zero deploy, zero to use and two characters who can use it this is by far the best hand weapon for you can add to your Light Side deck. It Slices! It Dices! It makes Julienne Fries!<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/hoth/light/small/anakinslightsaber.html</ref>

A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the card-type or stat bar, the game-text box and the numbers beside it) with the corrected game text, and below it a black strip with the title and a white E, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 January 2013.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-anakinslightsaber-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Anakin's Lightsaber]] (Decipher, 1996; Decipher's [[Anakin's Lightsaber (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes to Decipher's errata wording, the same words as [[Anakin's Lightsaber (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's November 1998 errata]]: “Deploy on your Skywalker of ability > 3. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Anakin’s Lightsaber” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
